title: Averaging over a block of random choices
statement: Let $x$ be a Boolean input, $B$ a natural-number register bound, and $F$ a function from natural numbers to rational numbers. For every natural number $\tau$ and register state $\sigma$, suppose the scratch register equals $\tau$, every register of $\sigma$ is at most $B$, and $2(\sigma_{nx}+1)2^{\operatorname{size}(\tau)}\le B$. Suppose also that for every natural number $i$ with $\sigma_{nx}2^{\operatorname{size}(\tau)}\le i<(\sigma_{nx}+1)2^{\operatorname{size}(\tau)}$, and every pair of natural numbers $b,e\le B$, the program has probabilistic semantics $F(i)$ from the designated loop state with registers $nx=i$, $tmp=0$, $b=b$, and $e=e$. Then the program from the designated initial state with register state $\sigma$ has probabilistic semantics $$\frac{\sum_{j<2^{\operatorname{size}(\tau)}}F(\sigma_{nx}2^{\operatorname{size}(\tau)}+j)}{2^{\operatorname{size}(\tau)}}.$$
hypotheses_covered: Every register of $\sigma$ is at most $B$
For every index in the specified half-open block and every $b,e\le B$, the loop-state configuration with the stated register updates has semantics $F(i)$
replaced:
Let $F$ assign a rational value to each natural number, let $x$ be a Boolean input, and
let $B$ be a natural-number register bound. For every $\tau$ and register state
$\sigma$, suppose the scratch register equals $\tau$, all registers are at most $B$, and
$2(\sigma_{nx}+1)2^{\operatorname{size}(\tau)}\le B$. Assume that for every index $i$ in
the block
$[\sigma_{nx}2^{\operatorname{size}(\tau)},(\sigma_{nx}+1)2^{\operatorname{size}(\tau)})$,
and every pair of natural numbers $b,e\le B$, the program at the designated loop state
with registers $nx=i$, $tmp=0$, and the two specified updates $b,e$ has probabilistic
semantics $F(i)$. Then the program at the designated initial state with register state
$\sigma$ has probabilistic semantics equal to the average of $F$ over that block:
$\displaystyle\frac{\sum_{j<2^{\operatorname{size}(\tau)}}F(\sigma_{nx}2^{\operatorname{size}(\tau)}+j)}{2^{\operatorname{size}(\tau)}}$.
